measurements.description: How many connected components survived every filter. Changes with the parameters in METADATA.parameters, which is why they travel with it.
Total volume of the union of accepted candidates, V = N_voxels * dR * dC * dS / 1000 on the source grid (MOS-IMG-040).
One accepted candidate's volume, same formula, same grid.
d = (6V/pi)^(1/3). NOT the long axis Fleischner size bands are defined against; see the private_code_rationale on the concept.

_note: MOS-SVC-022: the platform evaluates this and hands the service the series it
selected; the service MUST NOT enumerate the study to pick its own.
min_instances is 40 and not the platform floor of 2. A nodule detector needs
craniocaudal context: below ~40 slices at the spacings this envelope admits the
scan cannot cover the lungs, and every component a threshold finds is a partial
structure cut off by the scan extent. Refusing is honest; measuring is not.
REPORTED, not patched: `medos.worker.selection` implements ONE selector,
constants. A SeriesSelector document is not read by the worker in this build, so
the fields above are declared and enforced by this capability's own applicability
envelope rather than by the platform's selection step. Chapter 3 owns the
evaluation semantics that would make them platform-enforced.

constraints.rationale: The thresholds below are Hounsfield units. They are meaningless on any other modality.
A series whose Modality LUT was not applied carries stored values, not HU. Thresholding those produces a number for every case and a correct one for none.
See series_selector._note. The upper bound is a runtime guard, not a clinical one.

The smallest candidate this reports is 4 mm across. At dS > 3 mm a 4 mm lesion occupies one or two slices, so its volume -- and therefore its equivalent diameter -- is dominated by partial-volume averaging rather than by the lesion. LIDC-IDRI contains series at 0.6 to 3.0 mm and the upper bound is the top of that range, so the envelope is declared where the data is, not beyond it.

A 4 mm candidate is 4 in-plane voxels across at 1.0 mm. Coarser than that and the shape filters -- which are the only thing separating a nodule from a vessel cross-section -- are measuring the sampling grid.

MOS-IMG-021 makes reject the default for gantry tilt and this build applies no tilt correction. A sheared grid makes the bounding-box aspect ratio -- an accepted candidate's vessel filter -- wrong in a direction that admits vessels.
MOS-IMG-039/041: the measurement is computed on the source grid. A resampled volume has no inverse transform here, and a label map built on it would not align with the source SEG frame.

criteria.margin_rationale: DECLARED AND UNMET. This is the bar a lung nodule capability would have to clear before any clinical deployment; nothing in this repository has measured it, `evidence_reference` is null and `status` is `unmet`. The number is the bar, NOT a claim about this detector -- the detector emits no score at all, so `operating_point_id` and `score_threshold` are null, and MOS-SVC-021 therefore forbids displaying a sensitivity for it anywhere. Recorded so that MOS-EVID-090 REFUSES a transition to clinical_use_mode: clinical, which is the intended consequence.

Also declared and unmet, and stated because the sensitivity criterion alone is gameable by lowering the threshold until everything is a candidate. A connected-component detector with no classifier will not meet this; saying so up front is the point of writing it down.

The SUBGROUP FLOOR of section 7.9. `medos/medos/evidence/gate.py` is explicit that an aggregate cannot see a subgroup collapse -- 'passes a model that lost every sub-6 mm nodule' is the example it uses, and this is that stratum. Without this row a candidate that finds only large lesions clears the cohort-wide bar.

_note: MOS-REG-049: the clinical bar belongs to the Capability and the registry MUST
reject a service_version that declares clinical thresholds in its own manifest.
None of these numbers appears in medos/examples/lung-nodule/service-version.manifest.json,

clinical.intended_use: Research use only. Marks connected components in the lung fields of a chest CT whose size and shape are consistent with a nodule, so that a human reader can look at them. It is NOT a detection aid, NOT a triage tool, and its output is not evidence that a nodule is present or absent.
not_validated_for: Everything. No ValidationReport exists, acceptance_criteria.status is `unmet`, and no sensitivity or false-positive rate has been measured on any cohort.
Exclusion of disease. An empty candidate list means this algorithm's filters admitted nothing; it does NOT mean the lungs are clear.

Sizing. `candidate_equivalent_diameter_mm` is the equivalent SPHERICAL diameter and is systematically smaller than the long axis Fleischner and Lung-RADS bands are defined against. It MUST NOT be read into a size band.

Ground-glass and sub-solid nodules. A candidate must reach -200 HU (detector.CANDIDATE_HU_MIN), so a lesion whose density lies below that is not detected at all -- and that is the class where detection matters most. A ground-glass nodule typically sits between -700 and -400 HU, i.e. entirely below this threshold.

Juxtapleural and juxtavascular nodules. Detection here is hole-finding inside the air phase: a lesion touching the pleura or a large vessel is contiguous with the chest wall or the hilum, reaches the crop face, and is discarded by construction.
Any modality other than CT, any series outside the applicability envelope above, and any population -- the algorithm has never been run against an annotated cohort.

known_failure_modes.text: Vessel cross-sections are admitted as candidates. A pulmonary vessel running perpendicular to the axial plane is a compact, roughly circular, soft-tissue component of exactly the size of a small nodule, and no shape filter computed from a bounding box can separate the two.
known_failure_modes.mitigation: method_class is `deterministic_algorithm` and the SR finding type is the private code `finding.nodule_candidate`, whose code MEANING carries the words 'not clinically validated' so a viewer that ignores our metadata still shows them. Every candidate is drawn in the SEG for a reader to dismiss.

known_failure_modes.text: A lesion touching the pleura, the mediastinum or a hilar vessel is MISSED, not reported with lower confidence. The method finds structures enclosed by air; one that is contiguous with the body reaches the crop boundary and is dropped. In screening cohorts juxtapleural lesions are a large fraction of all nodules.
known_failure_modes.mitigation: None available within this method. Stated here and in not_validated_for because no output of a run makes it visible -- a study with one juxtapleural lesion and nothing else returns present=False, which is why present=False is documented as 'the filters admitted nothing' rather than as a negative.

known_failure_modes.text: The candidate count is a function of the HU threshold and the size window, not of the patient. Re-running at a different AIR_HU_MAX changes it, and two counts produced under different parameters are not comparable.
known_failure_modes.mitigation: Every parameter is in METADATA.parameters and reaches result_measurements.method_detail through the worker's provenance step, so a stored number can always be re-derived. A run whose candidate count exceeds MAX_PLAUSIBLE_CANDIDATES rejects rather than reporting, because a three-figure count is a broken threshold and not a patient.

known_failure_modes.text: Emphysematous, fibrotic and consolidated lung break the air-phase assumption. Consolidation removes the air that encloses a lesion; severe bullous disease creates air-filled cavities whose walls are enclosed soft-tissue components of nodule size and shape.
known_failure_modes.mitigation: The envelope above cannot check for this -- no DICOM attribute carries it -- so the envelope does NOT catch it and this entry says so rather than implying otherwise. LIDC-IDRI contains such cases and they were not excluded from the run.
